title.narrative: Training for Energy Auditors and Technical Designers (TEAD)

description.narrative: The project will provide trainings for energy auditors and technical designers. The project will contribute to the improvement of the quality of energy audits for all end users, including buildings, industries and SMEs by locally trained energy auditors. Energy audits will then be used by technical designers for the successful implementation of EE programmes in the areas of residential and public buildings as well as in industries and SMEs. The project has a specific gender focus.
